name: BaldMountain-OR

repair.capture_times: kept from the pre-fix fetch; each snapshot rebuilt from the rows cached under its time
repair.domain: pinned to the pre-fix domain (the rebuilt rings alone would give a different bbox)
repair.fidelity: re-read rings of all 52 cached OBJECTIDs reproduce the cached file exactly

snapshot_rule: first publication (smallest OBJECTID) per capture time; later same-time rows dropped as versions unless spatially disjoint (separate pieces, kept); growth gating on the first publication's acreage
